name: Parklands Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  MAY 9, 2011

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  May 9, 2011
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48
hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

CITIZEN APPLICATIONS

1.  PC-325-11; Application to remove 1 Liquidamber tree located in the city parkway
  adjacent to 2704 Via Anita

  Applicant:  Krista Badagliacca
  2704 Via Anita
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 24, 2011.
 2.  PC-326-11; Application to remove 10 Canary Island pine trees located in the city

  Applicant:  Salvador Munoz
  1916 Via Coronel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

3.  PC-327-11; Application to remove 3 Canary Island Pine trees located in the
  parklands adjacent to the rear of 2624 Via Carrillo

  Applicant:  Arlen Millman
  1200 Via Zumaya
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

OLD BUSINESS

4.  Letter to Karin Petersen concerning the tree planting policy and the February
  Parklands Committee meeting ‘Action Memo’.

NEW BUSINESS

None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

None

MINUTES

5.  Meeting of April 11, 2011.

ADJOURNMENT

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 24, 2011.
